findings.label: General sign provisions
findings.text: Retained page covers real-estate, home-occupation, institutional, nonconforming and temporary signs plus public right-of-way restrictions. Review sign type and current district applicability.

findings.label: Business/industrial dimensions and setbacks
findings.text: Retained page covers wall projections, sign area related to frontage, freestanding/pole signs, district exceptions and setbacks. This is a candidate reference; no dimensions are approved for a job.

findings.label: Illumination and sign application package
findings.text: Retained page covers illumination, permit exceptions, drawings, construction details and a printed application fee. Current exemptions and fees remain unverified.

findings.label: Illuminated-sign electrical permit candidate
findings.text: The retained clause calls for separate electrical permits and fees for illuminated signs/billboards and prints an IBI-like name. Canonical provider identity, currentness, permit issuer and inspection responsibility remain unapproved. The nearby building-code exemption must not be treated as a zoning-sign exemption.

findings.label: Zoning application: sign options and site plan
findings.text: Retained application includes permanent/temporary sign choices, display dates and a scaled site plan. Confirm current portal/paper route before using this older printed form.

findings.label: Commercial application: sign and illumination fields
findings.text: Retained application asks about illumination and ground-sign status. This form is separate from electrical approval.
